# The Fifth Tale

*A traveller on Winifred's step told a fifth version of the Balrog's coming, one she has never heard, and said he had it from someone by the wayside well on the Hedge Lanes. She wants to know if the well is real.*

## Objectives

- Reach the wayside well in [The Hedge Lanes](../maps/hedge_lanes.md)
- Defeat 25 [Orange Mushroom](../monsters/orange_mushroom.md) in [The Hedge Lanes](../maps/hedge_lanes.md)
